text:
mia: quick thread — proposing an "ownership ledger" pattern to stop postmortem actions from evaporating. low ceremony.
sam: yes pls. tired of 'owner TBD' or team-level owners.
mia: sketch: we keep a tiny ledger table (one row per action) that lives next to the postmortem and in a shared tracker. ledger fields: id, short title, owner, ETA, status, last_update, owner_history, link.
jess: simple is good. can we require owner confirmation within 48h? that was a missing step last time.
mia: yep — rule: owner must confirm ETA in 48h or IC auto-assigns temporary owner and flags the item "needs-confirmation". owner transfers must be logged in owner_history with timestamp.
kai: propose enforcement via incident-bot: set a 48h confirm reminder and 14d progress check. if no progress at 14d, bot pings IC + marks as "escalate".
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: "ledger-confirm: outage-2026-04" in 48 hours for @mia
sam: governance idea: single remediation owner per action. IC only intervenes if owner doesn't confirm or if item blocked for >7 days.
mia: cadence: weekly async ledger update until 80% closed, then biweekly until all done. also a 30d verification entry where SRE confirms monitoring + smoke test.
jess: i'll make a one-row copy/paste snippet and a small google sheet that mirrors the ledger. will post link in #eng-oncall by EOD.
kai: IC rotation tweak: shorten to 5 weeks for better overlap with product sprints. pilot for 2 cycles. IC should add a 1-paragraph handoff note when rotation happens.
sam: metrics to measure the pilot: pct confirmed at 48h, pct closed by 30d, number of escalations, average owner transfers. we can wire those counts to the sheet dashboard.
mia: immediate tasks:
- ledger snippet + sheet (jess) — due EOD tomorrow
- runbook paragraph with rules + sample ledger row (mia) — due Wed
- incident-bot rules for 48h/14d/30d (kai) — due Fri
- backfill current postmortems into ledger and ping owners (sam) — due in 3 days
jess: will do minimal columns only. no fancy dashboards to start. just counts by status.
kai: dev-bot will also add an "escalated-by-IC" tag when IC reassigns so we can track reassign frequency.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: "ledger-check: outage-2026-04 (14d)" in 14 days for @sam @jess
sam: agree on transparency — owner_history column is required so transfers are visible. can we also add a tiny "reason if deferred" field when something is postponed? adds accountability.
mia: yes — add deferred_reason (short text) and a forced ETA if deferred.
jess: sharing sheet link in 2 hours. i'll include a clipboard-friendly row template for postmortems.
kai: i'll publish the IC handoff template and post the rotation signup.
sam: let's pilot this for the next two incidents. if it meaningfully reduces drift we bake the ledger into the runbook. low friction + visible consequences.
mia: thanks all. owners please update the ledger before weekly summaries. :thumbsup:
